Nelson Mandela Marg, Vasant Kunj, New Delhi - 110070

================================================================================

OFFICIAL NOTICE: PGRC GRIEVANCE SCREENING OUTCOME
Ref No.   : AICTE/FD/COMP-OUTCOME/PGRC/CLG-2026-000001/1793021735727-1847
Date      : 26/10/2026

To,
The Principal / Director,
Bharatiya Institute of Technology
Institution ID: CLG-2026-000001

SUBJECT: OFFICIAL DETERMINATION OF PGRC COMPLIANCE STATUS

Dear Sir / Madam,

This is to inform that the institutional records and complaints referred to the Public Grievance Redressal Cell (PGRC) concerning Bharatiya Institute of Technology have been scrutinized under AICTE statutory compliance regulations.

FINDING STATUS: REJECTED
DEPARTMENT    : PGRC
COMPLAINT REF : PGRC-2026-362241
DECISION CAUSE: Inspection confirmed complete absence of mandatory safety equipment.

DETERMINATION SUMMARY:
One or more grievances/allegations against the institution stand PROVEN upon inquiry. Corrective regulatory measures and statutory conditions apply.

Yours faithfully,

Authorized Officer
Finance & Statutory Compliance Division
All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
================================================================================
reason: Inspection confirmed complete absence of mandatory safety equipment.
